title: The footer says why the email was sent; there is no unsubscribe link
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save.
  3. Open Customers, open customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' (create it if missing), open its Assets tab and open unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' (create it with New Asset if missing). Open the asset's Maintenance tab. If the unit is not on the schedule, press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', enter a last service date for PM-A about seven months ago (for example 6 Mar 2026) and press Enroll. PM-A now reads Overdue on the Maintenance tab.
  4. Make sure 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' has its Send preventive maintenance notifications setting on, and a contact 'Dave Brabay' with an email address you can read (for example a QA mailbox) set as the preferred contact of unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402'.
  5. On the QA environment, send only to a mailbox the QA team controls.
custom_steps:
1. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders (the worklist). On 402's row press Contact, then Send reminder, then Send.
  2. Open the email in the mailbox and read the footer.
  3. Look for any unsubscribe link anywhere in the email.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The footer states why the customer received it (in the design: Sent because <customer> is the contact for this unit at <organization>., for example Sent because ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co is the contact for this unit at the shop's organization).
  • There is no unsubscribe link: consent is the Send preventive maintenance notifications setting on the customer record.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10575 (S19, The customer reminder email (sent by hand)); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S19; Design MR_V2_2 (Claude Design export, 6 Oct 2026), driven in full on 6 Oct 2026, Chunk 2 board artboard R1; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-R15: “The footer will state why the customer received it. There is no unsubscribe link: consent is managed by a setting on the customer record, not by a link in the mail”
  • Design, Chunk 2 board, artboard R1, email footer: “Sent because Aacrest Works is the contact for this unit at Northline Heavy Duty.”
